avis.texte: I've been using Dermalogica products for 36 years. This cleanser recently made a few changes to its formula. I'm finding it to be a nice improvement. My skin is well moisturized after daily use.

I first tried Dermalogica's Daily Superfoliant when I got it as part of a promotion Ulta was running a few years back. When I recently decided to overhaul my self-care routine, I remembered how amazing this stuff made my face feel and grabbed a bottle. I have no idea how I managed to go several years without it after my initial try, but being reunited with this Holy Grail truly feels SO good! I can almost literally feel my skin breathe after using this product. Two uses is all it took for my pores to look visibly cleaner -- and I have a serious problem with visible pores on my nose. I did have a few pimples pop up immediately after the second use, but nothing close to a breakout and the rest of my care routine took care of them. Since they were in some of my more notorious problem spots, I suspect this is a result of the detox ingredients drawing the nasties out to the surface of my skin, which is what it's designed to do. Like the headline says: this stuff will make your face so smooth and clean it will literally squeak. I have never experienced that from another skin care product. It's honestly a little scary... but SO satisfying! Genuinely powerful stuff. I can confirm that back when I got the initial sample, the gal doing the demonstration did mention that it can be too harsh for those with sensitive skin. She recommended using the Superfoliant once per week and the Microfoliant daily. I have a combination skin type that loves to cake itself in oil, dirt, and dead skin th

avis.texte: This product is great for exfoliation and lathers really well. I have semi sensitive skin with rosacea and I use this at night and have never had issues. I love how soft my skin feels after cleansing with Precleanse and this to follow. However the smell is HORRID. It smells like burnt electrical wires. I probably will never buy it again for this reason alone, and switch to another one of their cleansers.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: This has been my go to exfoliant for the past 3 years so am an og. I love dermalogica and it has given my skin an amazing turn around. I always swear by this and have put my friends on to it. I have nothing bad to say about it. I LOVE IT!!
I have been using this superfoliant for years. Gentle enough for daily use. .never dries out my skin. Dermalogica is a great brand..use their hydramist daily as well.
I didnt notice any changes in my skin. And if i used more than once in a week my skin became really dry even with moisturizer. Didnt help with blackheads.
It's a gentle, yet effective exfoliator. I use this 3-4 times per week!

I think Dermalogica is often overlooked. It is pricey but their products seem excellent. This cleanser cleans the skin without enormous amounts of foam. After rinsing off with water my face feels fresh and clean. Love it. I would explore more products in this line but there is usually no one there to help. Maybe they have cut back on staff.

Ulta, you provided great customer service. Dermalogica, this product was unfortunately a disappointment coming from your wonderful brand, after using and loving many of your products. Smells unappealing like ivory soap, and was drying to the skin. Such a surprise. Used one time, and it will unfortunately not be used a second time and will be tossed out. (love your natural and botanical scents - try masking the scent!)
I mistakenly bought this instead of the Microfoliant and it smells like cat litter when you get it wet. It's awful and doesn't work as well as the microfoliant.

I really liked this cleanser when i first got it about 2 months ago. I kept it in the shower and have been using it regularly. The smell never was 'good' but now it is straight up rancid smelling like it's gone bad. No, it is not expired. I would have bought this again until this happened.
This is a great clean product. I have been using it for years. I have sensitive skin and this does not cause irritation, redness or breakouts.
This is a great product. I have sensitive skin, and this product does not irritate or cause redness. I use it with the Special Cleansing Gel.

avis.titre: Really nice - makes my skin even and soft

I have been using for it about two weeks and so far I like it. It cleans well, does not make my face tight and I can use it on my eyes with no issue.

It literally felt like I was rubbing tiny shards of glass into my face and it stung really badly. Even after using it, it still feels like I have burns 2 hours later. This is so weird. I love how soft and clean my face feels after using this. Dermalogica has some of my favorite products and this is a new favorite!
I struggle with stress breakouts and post menopauseal breakouts. This works well using it daily. Seems likevits has completely removed any issues

I use this at least 5 days a week and the bottle lasts me 5+ months so it may seem pricey but it is worth it. Also leaves my skin so glowy and shiny and clean.

I would be careful with this one.

Now, I will say that I am not a sensitive-skin type, so I could see how it might cause some people to have a reaction because it has a lot of exfoliating ingredients and it sucks your pores CLEAN! I will probably use 2-4 times a week because it does an amazing job and won't need it every day.

My skin is brighter and this enhances the use of my skin care. Wear sunscreen

I used another brand that was supposed to be recommended by dermatologists and my skin reacted very negatively to. I was hesitant to try another brand, but after a lot of research decided to try your product. I have had zero reactions and I'm so glad I found this brand. It has been a game changer for me!

avis.titre: Try It - You Will Be Glad You Did
avis.texte: One of my first choices and it does make a difference. Polishes the skin without causing any irritation.

I have used Dermalogica products for sometime, but fell off that wagon several years ago. My facialist uses these products exclusively, and I have returned to using them. I do a double cleanse with Dermalogica oil and then use this cleanser. It is so pleasant to use, and feels as though it actually is moisturizing. I have noticed my skin is not nearly as dry and smooth. I would highly recommend.
Perfect for this weather that promotes dry skin- moisturizers the skin
I love this creamy cleanser. It feels so moisturizing while I'm cleansing my face. Can definitely tell it's hydrating while washing.
I just switched to this, after years of using the special cleansing gel. I like the way it feels, and leaves my skin softer.
I have been using this for over a year. I use it once a day and it has kept my skin free of blackheads and keeps my pores clear. This is a must-have for me and a part of my everyday routine.
I have always used Daily Microfoliant but gave this a try - I'm not disappointed - it's great.
I love these grey grains....makes my skin feel smooth and clean. The natural earthy smell is something I enjoy too
Absolutely love this exfoliant. I started using it in my mid twenties and honeslty feel like it's helped my aging skin so much.
I love this face wash , it's very moisturizing. I have used it for awhile now.
Just love this product. Its excellent quality and shows great results!

The smell of the product is not to my liking, and for a cleanser, I expected that using it would result in some sort of cleansing foam, but that was not the case. The product just felt like a sticky moisturizer that really didn't resemble any sort of cleanser. I'm hoping that Dermalogica will allow a return of this product because it just did not meet my expectations.
Feels smooth on skin and hasn't caused any breakouts of my sensitive skin. I am pleased so far and will continue to use.
I love the way my skin feels after use. I can see a difference in all around d appearance.

However, I do find myself gravitating towards this when I need something a bit stronger than the daily microfoliant.

I use every 2nd day as my skin is sensitive. I have not had a reaction to it. I have bought a lot of products over the years which I end up throwing out. This product and every other product I have bought from Dermalogica have been keepers.

I've been using microfoliant but decided to give the superfoliant a try after reading all the great reviews. I have acne prone skin but before using this product I had no acne thanks to my Dermalogica routine. The first few day I broke out around my jawline but I figure it's the product bringing out acne that was sitting underneath my skin but not noticeable to the eyes. I told myself if after two weeks I continue to breakout I will stop using superfoliant and go back to microfoliant. Less than a week my acne started to dry up and disappear also my skin has brightened and my skin texture is nice and soft. I will continue to use this product until its finish which will be a while I have the big bottle and a little goes a long way.

I love this product. My fine lines are smoothed out and the ingredients are good for your skin. The package also has an insert to let you know how to use the product. The little beads really exfoliate my skin beautifully.

This product does so much for my skin. Exfoliating and makes my skin feel cleaner. It gives an amazing feeling after using this product.

love love this exfoliant. I use it every morning & it makes my skin feel smooth and it helps with the asporbtion of the other skin products. I have noticed a big difference in my skin since using the skin products for someone who is in their mid 60's.

I highly recommend this product if you have sensitive, dry skin.
